about.subtitle: B/C Dual-Loop Review · AI-style risk assessment and auto-revision for long documents

intro.title: What is this app
intro.desc1: AutoDocxProofread focuses on AI-style risk assessment of long documents: lane B evaluates structural style risk, lane C evaluates content style risk; above your thresholds it revises and re-reviews in a loop.
intro.desc2: Reviews must cite verbatim evidence from the source text, and a deterministic statistical layer (template phrases, sentence-length uniformity, etc.) cross-checks the model, so invalid results never pass.
intro.feature1L1: Lane B (structure): skeleton isomorphism, repetitive section transitions, structural duplication
intro.feature1L2: Lane C (content): weak verbs, vague claims, one-sided argumentation, missing concrete detail
intro.feature1L3: Lanes never see each other; scores are length-weighted and cross-checked
intro.feature2L1: Any lane above threshold triggers revise → save candidate → dual re-review (rounds configurable)
intro.feature2L2: Revisions must reference concrete issues with evidence and pass validation before saving
intro.feature2L3: Original file is byte-protected; all intermediate versions are kept and exportable
intro.feature3L1: Five statistical features: template phrases, connective density, sentence-length CV, 4-gram repetition, punctuation diversity
intro.feature3L2: Signals are injected as independent evidence; strong signals under-scored by the model are floor-lifted and annotated
intro.feature3L3: External phrase table (heuristic-phrases.json) grows with your domain — the more you feed it, the sharper it gets
intro.feature4L1: Heading-aligned chunking keeps whole sections together; tiny sections merge
intro.feature4L2: Chunks run in parallel (3 per lane) under concurrency and rate limits
intro.feature4L3: Validation failures retry with feedback, then split chunks in half as fallback
intro.feature5L1: OpenAI-compatible APIs, Claude and Gemini; keys encrypted at rest
intro.feature5L2: All four roles (B / C / structure revise / content revise) can use separate APIs or local Codex CLI
intro.feature5L3: Concurrency, requests-per-minute, timeout and thinking mode are configurable
intro.feature6L1: Per-round score comparison, paragraph risks, evidence quotes and revision diffs
intro.feature6L2: Export final DOCX, Markdown report, or full version ZIP bundle
intro.feature6L3: Past runs are restorable; failed runs can restart from the original
intro.warningDesc: B and C use different prompts; if they share the same underlying model, results may correlate. Scores are internal heuristics, not calibrated probabilities, and cannot prove authorship.
intro.warningDesc2: The loop converges on scores; too many rounds risk over-editing. Review diffs each round — returns usually diminish after 2–3 rounds.
intro.tip1Desc: Add domain-specific AI clichés to heuristic-phrases.json under the app data folder (auto-created on first run); restart to apply.
intro.tip2Desc: Higher is looser (80 ≈ block only widespread risk). Try 25–40 to tighten, then adjust per round comparison.

guide.title: Guide
guide.step1L1: Open the API settings page from the sidebar
guide.step1L2: Add a config: provider type, base URL, key, model name
guide.step1L4: Confirm the dual-review page shows the intended model as current API
guide.step2L1: Pick a DOCX on the dual-review page (heading styles recommended)
guide.step2L2: Set discipline, max rounds, B/C risk thresholds
guide.step2L3: Optionally assign separate APIs or local Codex CLI to each role
guide.step3L1: Start the loop; progress counts text blocks (jumps in chunks — that is normal)
guide.step3L2: Inspect per-round scores, evidence quotes and program signals
guide.step3L3: Above threshold triggers revision and re-review; unresolved issues are all listed
guide.step4L1: Export final DOCX / report / version ZIP
guide.step4L2: Restore past runs from the dropdown
guide.step4L3: Feed recurring missed clichés into the external phrase table

rateLimit.title: Requests Per Minute Limit
rateLimit.description: Limit the number of requests sent to the model per minute. Default is unlimited. If your API provider has rate limits, enable this according to their requirements
rateLimit.timeoutHint: Timed-out segments are treated as failed; default 300s

thinking.title: Deep Thinking
thinking.description: Controls the reasoning (thinking) switch for OpenAI-compatible APIs (DeepSeek, Doubao, GLM, etc.). Note: some providers enable thinking by default (e.g. DeepSeek) and thinking tokens are billed
thinking.hint: When enabled, the chain of thought streams in the progress info area; disabling it significantly reduces token usage

concurrency.title: Concurrency Settings
concurrency.description: Set maximum concurrency limit. The specific value depends on your API provider's limits. Higher concurrency can improve processing speed

proxy.title: Proxy Settings
proxy.description: Configure HTTP proxy for network requests. Disabled by default, default port is 7890
